notes.title: Lame Defenders release in early access!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40430035/18e57378ebe002239274cd506ce6269523a99856.png[/img]

Hello guys, I decided to release Lame Defenders into early access. The game is currently playable, especialy first few arenas have many waves set up (but will be modified in the future probably). There are 30 heroes for hire and over 30 enemies growing in strength with every wave. Some later arenas have only few monster waves and are more for testing purposes - especially for testing out new monsters and skills.

Please consider this game as a small heroes vs monsters playground that lets you try different combinations of heroes and their skills. There is 150 skills you can use and many more skills used by your enemies.

I will be really happy if you try the game and provide some constructive feedback.

notes.title: DevLog - Heroes
notes.content:
Lame Defenders is a game of heroes and monsters. But of course heroes are much more important for the player!  So let's introduce few of them.

[h2]Next Door Jerry[/h2]
[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40430035/6e4f3f98ca78df2d77bdd37f5dc7df4ed3544977.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40430035/26f931c1f7ab2745cd06c3f490de6a043d2fe4a5.png[/img][/url]
Jerry lives just next door to the local tavern where he likes to pick fights with all the cocky adventurers. Sure, from time to time he loses a tooth but that doesn't stop him jumping into fight again and again. Finally, someone gave him advice to join the war against monsters. So he is here, punching...

[h2]Glacia[/h2]
[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40430035/c820f137405032a67641f247232d81cac1155d9c.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40430035/5bd0b63e7aa48be57ea486bf36bec70c7a823c19.png[/img][/url]
Glacia was born in a frozen land of Mallan. She is a half-god half-human being which makes her a great asset in war against monsters thanks to strong godly powers. Glacia can control ice and freeze her enemies to death.

[h2]Bear Hunter Todd[/h2]
[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40430035/8442c50b93ac04cd75f592dae66670e86c7fcd87.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40430035/8edeff4c4aca735dbe5997d9a0945dc09d3b325c.png[/img][/url]
They call him the bear hunter. Not because he hunts bears but because he always carry a huge bear trap with him - for some reason. But hey, the trap becomes very handy around all the monster. Finally it has some meaning.

These cool heroes and many more are awaiting your command in Lame Defenders!
